Rebel ships are coming into our sector.''"
"''Good. Our first catch of the day.|Lieutenant Cabbel and Captain Lennox during the Battle of Hoth|audio=Cabbel-Lennox.flac|}} '''Cabbel''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy]] and a [[controller]] aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyrant]]'', a part of the [[Death Squadron]] [[fleet]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], the fleet was [[Project Swarm|tasked]] with finding the secret headquarters of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and ultimately located the [[Echo Base|base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]] in [[3 ABY]]. While the ''Tyrant'' and the rest of Death Squadron formed a [[blockade]] over the world as [[Blizzard Force|Imperial ground forces]] [[Battle of Hoth|assaulted]] the base, the [[Alliance Military|rebel forces]] below began their evacuation. The first rebel [[GR-75 medium transport|transport]] launched was the ''[[Quantum Storm]]'', which the ''Tyrant'' moved to intercept. On the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer's]] [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], Cabbel informed the ''Tyrant''{{'s}} [[captain]], [[Lennox]], of the approaching rebel [[Starship|vessel]]. A [[tractor beam]] was used in an attempt to capture the [[transport]]; however, a shot from the Alliance's Hoth-based [[V-150 Planet Defender|ion cannon]] disabled the ''Tyrant'', allowing the ''Quantum Storm'' to escape. ==Biography== [[File:ExecutorEscort-BTMF27.png|thumb|left|250px|Cabbel was a part of Death Squadron.]] Cabbel{{Topps|set=Star Wars Force Attax: The Force Awakens|cardname=Lieutenant Cabbel|link=https://www.tradingcarddb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/122192/cid/8287769/2016-Topps-Star-Wars-Force-Attax-The-Force-Awakens-41-Lieutenant-Cabbel}} was a [[human]] member of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Officer Corps]], serving in the [[Imperial Navy]]'s [[Imperial Navy's officer corps|faction]]. In [[3 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} to [[3 ABY]]. during the [[Galactic Civil War]], Cabbel held the [[military rank]] of [[lieutenant]] and was stationed as a [[controller]] on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]]{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|4|History of the Ship}} ''[[Tyrant]]''.{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Toryn Farr - Communications Officer}} The ''Tyrant'' was [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by [[Captain]] [[Lennox]]{{Topps|set=Star Wars Force Attax: The Force Awakens|cardname=Captain Lennox|link=https://www.tradingcarddb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/122192/cid/8287767/2016-Topps-Star-Wars-Force-Attax-The-Force-Awakens-39-Captain-Lennox}} and served as one of the five [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] in [[Death Squadron]], the personal [[fleet]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' Arriving at the [[planet]] [[Hoth]], the location of the [[Echo Base|secret headquarters]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Death [[Squadron]], including ''Tyrant'', formed a [[blockade]] around the planet while [[Blizzard Force|ground forces]] were [[Battle of Hoth|deployed]] to destroy a [[Deflector shield|shield]] protecting the rebel base from [[orbital bombardment]]. The Alliance began evacuating all personnel from its base, with the first escape [[Starship|vessel]] launched being the [[GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Quantum Storm]]'', escorted by two [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]s. As the trio of starships left Hoth, the ''Tyrant'' moved to block their path,''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'' and Cabbel approached Lennox on the [[Star Destroyer]]'s bridge to inform him that the rebel vessels were approaching their sector. [[File:Lennox_Cabbel.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Cabbel served aboard the ''Tyrant''.]] In order to capture the enemy ships with a [[tractor beam]], the ''Tyrant'' lowered its shields, unknowingly giving an opening to a [[v-150 Planet Defender]] [[ion cannon]] that the Alliance had built in its base below. The [[cannon]] fired several shots at the ''Tyrant'', disabling the vessel and sending it careening away into [[Realspace|space]] as the rebel vessels escaped the [[star system]]. Ultimately the Empire claimed victory at Hoth, although many other rebel vessels also succeeded in escaping. ==Personality and traits== Cabbel had fair skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]]. ==Equipment== Cabbel wore a standard olive-gray [[Navy|naval]] [[Imperial officer|officer's]] [[Imperial officer's uniform|uniform]] including an [[Imperial kepi]]. On his left [[breast]], he bore a single [[code cylinder]] and a [[rank insignia plaque]] with two red bars over two blue. ==Behind the scenes== Cabbel was portrayed by [[Oliver Maguire]]{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsautographcollecting.com/Autographs/StarWarsTrilogy/ESB/OliverMaguire.htm|text=Trilogy Autographs|work=[http://www.starwarsautographcollecting.com Dahoov's Autograph Collecting]|quote=Oliver Maguire was Lt. Cabbel in ''Star Wars: Empire Strikes Back''.|archivedate=20040929002343}} in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. Maguire was credited only as one of several "Other Officers," with the film's script describing the character as a controller.''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' The character first received his name in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] on a card in the [[2015]] [[Star Wars Force Attax: The Force Awakens|''2015 Topps Star Wars Force Attax The Force Awakens'']] set of trading cards released by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]] The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared on a card for the [[1998]] ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Cabbel}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Cabbel}} *{{Film|V}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]] *[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (Screen Comix)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' Screen Comix]] ==Sources== *{{ForceAttax|set=Star Wars Force Attax: The Force Awakens|cardname=Lieutenant Cabbel|link=https://www.tradingcarddb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/122192/cid/8287769/2016-Topps-Star-Wars-Force-Attax-The-Force-Awakens-41-Lieutenant-Cabbel}} {{1stID|Cabbel}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Battle of Hoth and the Second Death Star}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|imperial-star-destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Death Squadron personnel]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
